title: Clinical SOAP Note Writer
description: Converts raw clinical encounter notes into a fully structured SOAP note with Assessment and Plan sections.

title: Differential Diagnosis Assistant
description: Generates a ranked differential diagnosis list from a clinical presentation, with supporting reasoning and red-flag alerts.

title: Patient Education Explainer
description: Translates a clinical diagnosis, procedure, or medication into clear patient education material at a 6th–8th grade reading level.

title: Prior Authorization Letter Writer
description: Drafts a compelling, evidence-based prior authorization letter to an insurance payer for medications, procedures, or diagnostic tests.

title: Hospital Discharge Summary Generator
description: Generates a complete hospital discharge summary from admission and progress notes, formatted for the primary care provider handoff.

title: High-Converting Ad Copy Generator
description: Generates 3 ad copy variants using different psychological hooks for Facebook, Instagram, Google, or LinkedIn campaigns.

title: Email Drip Sequence Writer
description: Writes a complete multi-email nurture sequence with subject lines, preview text, and body copy designed to move leads to purchase.

title: Brand Voice Extractor & Style Guide Builder
description: Analyzes sample brand content and produces a reusable brand voice guide with vocabulary rules, do/don't examples, and tone variations by channel.

title: SEO Content Brief Writer
description: Generates a detailed SEO content brief including search intent analysis, page structure, semantic keywords, and competitive differentiation notes.

title: Product Launch Announcement Pack
description: Generates a coordinated launch pack — press release, launch email, and platform-specific social posts — all aligned in messaging and tone.

title: Code Review Assistant
description: Performs a structured code review flagging bugs, security issues, and style violations with severity ratings and specific fix suggestions.

title: Unit Test Generator
description: Generates a comprehensive unit test suite covering the happy path, edge cases, error conditions, and boundary values in the framework of your choice.

title: Bug Root Cause Explainer
description: Analyzes a bug report and code to identify the root cause, explain why it happens, and provide a specific fix with a regression test.

title: API Documentation Writer
description: Generates structured API reference documentation from a route or function — including parameters, response schemas, error codes, and code examples.

title: SQL Query Optimizer
description: Analyzes a slow SQL query, identifies performance problems, rewrites it with optimizations, and provides index recommendations with execution plan guidance.

title: Investment Thesis Writer
description: Structures a rigorous investment thesis covering the core opportunity, key assumptions, risk factors, and catalysts for public or private companies.

title: Earnings Call Analyzer
description: Extracts key signals from an earnings call transcript — guidance changes, management tone shifts, analyst concerns, and forward-looking statements.

title: Budget Variance Analyst
description: Analyzes actual vs. budget financial data, explains root causes of variances, and produces management commentary ready for finance review.

title: Personal Financial Plan Builder
description: Builds a structured, prioritized personal financial plan with debt payoff strategy, savings targets, and a 12-month milestone roadmap.

title: Financial Report Summarizer
description: Summarizes a 10-K, 10-Q, or annual report into an executive summary highlighting revenue trends, margin changes, cash flow signals, and key risks.
